title: Jobs to Be Done
equation: Product-Market Fit = Job Definition × Job Performance × Hiring Trigger Awareness
hook: Your customer isn't a 35-year-old in the suburbs. They're someone trying to get something done.
statement: Customers hire a product to do a job for them. Demographics don't explain why they buy.
explainer: One food chain found most morning milkshakes were bought for long commutes. The real job was a boring drive and an empty stomach. Once they knew that, they changed the shake, and sales went up.
sop: Ask real customers about the moment they decided to buy.
Name the practical job they needed done.
Name the social and emotional side of it too.
Find out what made them drop the alternatives.
Shape your product and messaging around that whole job.
equation_example: Score each 1 to 10. Job Definition 8, Job Performance 6, Hiring Trigger Awareness 5. 8 × 6 × 5 = 240 out of 1,000. Higher means everything you say speaks to the real job. Lower means you're listing features while customers shop for an outcome.
question: Finish this sentence for your best customer: they hired us to help them...
closing_statement: Sell the job, not the demographic.
caption:
